The merchant {npc:Tarun}, in the Tiquanda jungle, has lost his brother, who followed a beautiful woman to a luxurious palace. Enter the Asura Palace, go up to the fourth floor and find his remains. You receive 3000 experience, a {item:Red Gem}, the ability to trade with Tarun and, if you have already done the Asura Palace Quest, the achievement **Lost Palace Raider**.
Help a merchant find out what happened to his brother, who followed a beautiful woman to a luxurious palace.
No minimum level, but the recommended level is **200+** (the Asura Palace is dangerous).
For the achievement **Lost Palace Raider**: having completed the {wiki:Asura Palace Quest|Asura Palace Quest} beforehand.
Enough potions to cross the {wiki:Asura Palace|Asura Palace} up to the 4th floor
Achievement **Lost Palace Raider** (only if you have already completed the Asura Palace Quest)
At the end, when you give the news to {npc:Tarun} ({key:mission}).
It is a requirement for the Within the Tides Quest.
With the {item:Asuri Talisman} (part 1 of that quest) you can use the portal in the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains|Kha'zeel Mountains} to {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}.
The quest appears in the Quest Log inside **Adventurers Guild**.
You do not need to kill the elementals in the final room: you just have to reach the skeleton.

{npc:Tarun} is in the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle, next to the wooden bridge on the jungle side of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}. The simplest way is from **Ankrahmun**: leave the city to the **west** and climb the mountains ({creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}), cross the bridge up there (there is a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and go down until you reach a staircase that takes you to the jungle side. You can also come on foot from **Port Hope**, **east** through the jungle.

Go to the **Tiquanda** jungle and look for {npc:Tarun}, near the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass|Kha'zeel Pass}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. His brother disappeared after going to the cursed palace to the **north**.
Walk **north** from Tarun until you reach the {wiki:Asura Palace|Asura Palace}.

The palace is full of {creature:Dawnfire Asura|Dawnfire Asuri}, {creature:Midnight Asura|Midnight Asuri}, {creature:Frost Flower Asura|Frost Flower Asuri} and {creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns}. Enter carefully.
Go up to the fourth floor

Fight your way to the palace's **fourth floor**. In the **north-east** part of the room walk over the {item:Some Cracks|cracks in the floor} ({wiki:Some Cracks|Some Cracks}): you fall into a room below.

In the room where you land there are two fire elementals. Kill them or ignore them and walk to the square **south** of the {item:Skeleton (Object)|skeleton}. The message *"You stumble over some old bones. Something is carved into the stone wall here: 'Tarun, my brother, you were right. She's evil.'"* appears and your Quest Log is updated.
The elementals are {creature:Greater Fire Elemental|Greater Fire Elementals} (before the Summer Update 2022 they were {creature:Massive Fire Elemental|Massive Fire Elementals}).

The wiki does not describe an exit specific to the elementals' room: look for the way out of the room and then go back down the palace the same way you came up, to the ground-floor entrance. From there go back **south** to {npc:Tarun}.

Go back to {npc:Tarun} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He is sad to learn that his brother has died, but thanks you with a {item:Red Gem} and 3000 experience. If you have already completed the {wiki:Asura Palace Quest|Asura Palace Quest}, you also receive the achievement **Lost Palace Raider**. From now on you can trade with Tarun.
Red Gem + 3000 experience (+ Lost Palace Raider)
To go back, follow the Kha'zeel Pass **east** to Ankrahmun (the arrival route in reverse) or return through the jungle to Port Hope.
This quest is part of the {wiki:Adventurers Guild (Quest)|Adventurers Guild} quests.
